_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil stats (3% of 12h windows move ±2+) make HOLD the graded call, and neither breaker is present — ETF flows remain at zero and VIX at 63 — so the honest read is to sit in Anxiety and wait for confirmation either way.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD/CAUTION with medium conviction citing divergent factors, while the narrative writer implies a forward relief rally with 0.77 confidence; the split is direction vs patience.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows > 20 AND vix < 50 — institutional return with macro calm would validate the bottom analog and allow a move to Hope
next_move.invalidated_if: funding > 65 AND btc_momentum_30d < 40 — leveraged longs trapped would force a drop to Complacency or Panic, killing the bottom thesis
